essay: AI in education uses tools like adaptive tutoring systems and chatbots to fit teaching to each student's pace and needs. It can give quick, patient feedback on writing, coding, and problem-solving, which one teacher can't do for every student at once. Teachers can hand off routine jobs, like writing quizzes and grading assignments, and spend that time on mentoring and discussion. But there are real risks, including wrong answers, overreliance that weakens critical thinking, and unequal access to technology. AI works best when it supports skilled teachers and comes with clear guidelines that keep students actively thinking for themselves.
